#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Trinity Compress - Pre-run prompt compression for iterative AI dev loops
# Requires: bash 4+, jq, bc

set -euo pipefail

MODE="${1:-balanced}"
CONFIG_FILE="trinity-compress.config.json"
BACKUP_EXT=".bak"

usage() {
    echo "Usage: $0 [balanced|aggressive|undo]"
    echo "  balanced  - Default compression mode"
    echo "  aggressive - Maximum compression (may reduce clarity)"
    echo "  undo      - Restore from .bak backups"
    exit 1
}

check_requirements() {
    command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Error: jq is required"; exit 1; }
    command -v bc >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Error: bc is required"; exit 1; }
    [[ "${BASH_VERSINFO[0]}" -ge 4 ]] || { echo "Error: bash 4+ is required"; exit 1; }
}

create_backups() {
    while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
        if [[ -f "$file" && ! "$file" =~ $BACKUP_EXT$ ]]; then
            cp "$file" "${file}${BACKUP_EXT}"
            echo "Backed up: $file"
        fi
    done < <(find . -type f \( -name "*.md" -o -name "*.txt" \) -print0 2>/dev/null)
}

compress_file() {
    local file="$1"
    local mode="$2"
    local content
    content=$(cat "$file")
    
    # Remove excessive whitespace (preserving code blocks)
    content=$(echo "$content" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')
    
    if [[ "$mode" == "aggressive" ]]; then
        # Additional aggressive compression
        content=$(echo "$content" | sed 's/  */ /g')
    fi
    
    echo "$content" > "$file"
    echo "Compressed: $file"
}

run_compression() {
    create_backups
    while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
        if [[ -f "$file" && ! "$file" =~ $BACKUP_EXT$ ]]; then
            compress_file "$file" "$MODE"
        fi
    done < <(find . -type f \( -name "*.md" -o -name "*.txt" \) -print0 2>/dev/null)
    echo "Compression complete (mode: $MODE)"
}

undo_compression() {
    local count=0
    while IFS= read -r -d '' bakfile; do
        local orig="${bakfile%.${BACKUP_EXT}}"
        cp "$bakfile" "$orig"
        rm "$bakfile"
        echo "Restored: $orig"
        ((count++))
    done < <(find . -type f -name "*.bak" -print0 2>/dev/null)
    if [[ $count -eq 0 ]]; then
        echo "No backups found to restore"
    else
        echo "Restored $count file(s)"
    fi
}

main() {
    check_requirements
    
    case "$MODE" in
        balanced|aggressive)
            run_compression
            ;;
        undo)
            undo_compression
            ;;
        *)
            usage
            ;;
    esac
}

main
